_comment.port: USB-serial device path. Pi 5 typically enumerates the Pico as /dev/ttyACM0. If you have multiple ACM devices (e.g. Pixhawk also on ttyACM0), check `ls /dev/serial/by-id/` for a stable symlink and use that.
_comment.baud: USB CDC ignores baud rate but pyserial requires a value. 115200 is the MicroPython convention.
_comment.brightness: Default brightness scale 0..255 applied on connect. 48 is comfortable indoor; bump higher for daylight.
